card.title: Social Group
card.description: Practise communication, teamwork, friendship and confidence with peers.

sections.title: Social Group
sections.intro: Rising Tree social groups create structured opportunities to practise communication and social participation in a supportive peer setting. Activities are designed to be engaging, practical and connected to real-world interaction.

sections.title: Support built around everyday participation.
sections.intro: Therapy goals are individual. These examples show common areas that may be explored when they are relevant to the person and their priorities.

items.title: Conversation
items.description: Starting, maintaining and ending conversations in a natural way.

items.title: Turn-taking
items.description: Practising shared attention, listening and flexible participation.

items.title: Teamwork
items.description: Working with others, sharing roles and solving problems together.

items.title: Friendship skills
items.description: Building confidence in connecting with peers and maintaining positive interactions.

items.title: Self-regulation
items.description: Recognising feelings, managing frustration and participating in group routines.

items.title: Confidence
items.description: Practising skills in a supportive setting where mistakes are part of learning.

panels.title: Goals first, service second.
paragraphs: Group placement depends on age, goals, group compatibility, current program availability and the level of support required.
We start by understanding what is working well, what feels difficult and what meaningful change would look like in daily life. From there, the clinician can recommend a suitable next step.

items.title: Start with your priorities
items.description: Tell us what matters, what is currently difficult and what you hope to change.

items.title: Understand strengths & needs
items.description: Your clinician gathers relevant information and completes assessment where appropriate.

items.title: Build practical strategies
items.description: Sessions focus on meaningful goals and strategies that make sense in real routines.

items.title: Review & adapt
items.description: Progress is reviewed together and the plan is adjusted as needs and goals change.

sections.title: Before you get started.
sections.intro: These answers are general. We can discuss individual circumstances when you contact the team.

items.question: How are groups formed?
items.answer: Groups are usually matched around factors such as age, communication needs, goals and group compatibility.

items.question: Can group therapy complement individual therapy?
items.answer: Yes. Group programs can provide a useful setting to practise skills that have been introduced individually.

items.question: Are social groups always running?
items.answer: Programs may be offered at selected times. Contact the team for current group availability and upcoming intakes.
